snippet.description:
Is it you, or is it the economy? 

You’ve sent the applications. You’ve done the coffee chats. Nothing. At some point you start to wonder what’s broken: you, or the job market?

There is arguably no one better equipped to answer this question than Claudia Sahm. Claudia invented what’s known as the “Sahm Rule,” one of the most respected rules in macroeconomics. You can think of it like a smoke detector for the economy. It beeps in warning when certain conditions are met. 

In this episode: Claudia explains why it feels so hard to find a job right now, why a “stable” labor market is not necessarily a good one, and what you can do about it. Plus: how she navigated the lowest points of her career (even legendary economists have to job hunt).

00:00 The economist behind one of the most respected rules in macroeconomics 
01:44 A message from AlphaSpace by Yahoo Finance 
02:33 From hog farm to the Fed 
05:35 Starting at the Fed during the 2008 financial crisis & Sahm Rule backstory 
12:00 What’s happening in the labor market (low hire, low fire) 
21:03 Job hunting tips 
24:24 Is it you, or the economy?  
29:33 “It’s ok to be different”
33:53 Get good at what’s valuable & visible 
35:33 Should you get a PhD? 
37:19 Do you quit your safe but boring job?
39:41 AI is better for mid-career professionals 
41:23 Claudia applies to be Punxsutawney Phil 
44:55 Luck questionnaire 

Follow Best of Luck on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/bestofluckpodcast
Follow Kyla Scanlon on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/kylascan 

Our theme song is "Frolic" by Jake Xerxes Fussell. Discover more of his music and tour dates here: https://www.jakexerxesfussell.com/

Produced by: Megan Cunnane, Wendy Mullin, Devan Joseph, Garrett Williams, Coby Weiss
